issues.title: PAL Gladiator: 5 matching C functions, reconstruction drafts and PS2Recomp findings
issues.author: Sumaiter
issues.body:
Sharing PAL Gladiator game reconstruction results from a local PS2Recomp-assisted inspection, compared against OpenRAC main at fe6ec0d2e9d209ad3a84dd33a188120ea12f030c.
The contribution is 5 new matching C functions (128 bytes), 3 unmatched C drafts, and a classified index of the translated main/frontend inventory. The 13,713 generated ranges are not claimed as 13,713 decompiled functions.
Source and evidence

Matching C and map/report changes — commit 73abe1b
